data.name: Minaarah
data.gender_notes: Minaarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A long and winding pathway, a journey towards a destination, a guide leading to a goal. The name Minaarah carries the meaning “Pathway, Journey” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Minaarah usually hope their child will grow to embody pathway, journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the spiritual journey towards Allah, a reminder to stay on the right path in life
data.etymology: Minaarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pathway, Journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minaarah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: منارة
in_arabic.meaning: منارة تعني المكان أو الشيء الذي يهدي وينير
in_arabic.long_meaning: منارة هي كلمة عربية تعني المكان أو الشيء الذي يهدي وينير، وغالبًا ما تستخدم للإشارة إلى المنارة التي ترشد السفن في البحر. في الإسلام، يمكن أن تشير إلى النور الذي يهدي الناس إلى الطريق الصحيح، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم. اسم منارة يوحي بالهداية والنور والإضاءة.

in_urdu.name: منارہ
in_urdu.meaning: منارہ کا مطلب ہے رہنمائی کرنے والا چیز یا مقام
in_urdu.long_meaning: منارہ ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رہنمائی کرنے والا چیز یا مقام۔ یہ اکثر اس مینار کو کہا جاتا ہے جو سمندر میں جہازوں کی رہنمائی کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، منارہ اس نور کو بھی کہا جاتا ہے جو لوگوں کو صحیح راستے پر چلنے کے لئے رہنمائی کرتا ہے، جیسے کہ قرآن میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ نام منارہ ہدایت، نور اور روشنی کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मीनाराह
in_hindi.meaning: मीनाराह का अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन करने वाला वस्तु या स्थान
in_hindi.long_meaning: मीनाराह एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन करने वाला वस्तु या स्थान। यह अक्सर उस मीनार को कहा जाता है जो समुद्र में जहाजों को मार्गदर्शन करता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, मीनाराह उस प्रकाश को भी कहा जाता है जो लोगों को सही रास्ते पर चलने के लिए मार्गदर्शन करता है, जैसा कि कुरआन में उल्लेख किया गया है। नाम मीनाराह मार्गदर्शन, प्रकाश और रोशनी को व्यक्त करता है।

in_pashto.name: منارہ
in_pashto.meaning: منارہ د هدايت کوونکی شی یا ځای معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: منارہ یو عربي کلمه ده چې معنی یې د هدايت کوونکی شی یا ځای دی. ډیری وختونه دا هغه منار ته ویل کیږي کوم چې په سمندر کې د کښتیو هدايت کوي. په اسلامي دود کې، منارہ هغه رڼا ته هم ویل کیږي کوم چې خلکو ته د سمو لارې موندلو لپاره هدايت کوي، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کې يې ذکر شوی دی. نوم منارہ هدايت، رڼا او روښنۍ څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Minaarah
in_english.meaning: Minaarah means guiding light or tower
in_english.long_meaning: Minaarah is derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-r' which means light or guidance. It refers to a guiding light or tower, often used to guide ships at sea. In Islamic tradition, Minaarah symbolizes the light that guides people to the right path, as mentioned in the Quran. The name Minaarah signifies guidance, illumination, and enlightenment, reflecting positive personality traits such as leadership and wisdom.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: منارہ (mu-NAH-rah)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: منارہ (muh-NAH-rah)

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the term "Minaarah" (منارة) is commonly used in the context of the Hajj pilgrimage to refer to a series of paths, roads, and walkways used by pilgrims to perform their rituals at various sites in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. The frequented and well-trodden paths experience millions of footsteps each year, symbolizing the collective journey of countless Muslims to the holiest site in Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: In a more profound sense, Minaarah can be seen as a metaphor for the guidance and direction provided by Allah (God) throughout our lives. Similarly, as we embark on our individual religious and spiritual journeys, we often find ourselves following the path laid out for us, seeking knowledge and understanding while making our way towards our ultimate goal of nearness to Allah. The term "Minaarah" serves as an inspiring reminder of the significance of taking one step at a time in our faith and trusting in the divine guidance that illuminates the way.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Pathway, Journey" symbolizes A long and winding pathway, a journey towards a destination, a guide leading to a goal. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Minaarah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of pathway, journey.
